description: Imports registrants into a webinar from a CSV text, one row per person. Take it when you bring a list from another tool or when someone pasted names into the chat: "Here is my list from the old system, put them in." It needs the session, the webinar, the CSV text and a clear yes from you. No email goes out unless the host asks for one: then set `send_signup_email` true, and only after they said those people may receive mail. The text is capped at 20000 characters per call, so a long list goes in parts. Nothing else on the campaign changes. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: import CSV, upload list, move my list, add registrants, pasted list

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that these people may be imported.

csv.description: The CSV text, one row per person, with a header row the site can read. At most 20000 characters per call.

send_signup_email.description: Default false: the people are imported and receive no email. Set it to true only when the host asks that the imported people get the sign-up email.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_import_registrants_csv
title: Import registrants from a CSV
